# Solar Velvet

Solar Velvet is a chill disco music project creating cinematic mixes inspired by golden hour, coastal drives, Riviera nights, dancefloor nostalgia, and endless summer.

Official website: https://solarvelvet.com/
Official YouTube channel: https://www.youtube.com/@solarvelvetmusic

## Releases

- Riviera Nights, episode 001: https://youtu.be/d-JhjZPDxJM
- Vinyl Nights, episode 002

## Site sections

- Latest release: https://solarvelvet.com/#latest
- About the duo: https://solarvelvet.com/#story
- Albums and sessions: https://solarvelvet.com/#albums

Preferred name: Solar Velvet
Primary genre: Chill disco
